d: Magnificent place in the Capitol with Throne. Alexander, Sallustia, Martian, Claudio, Peoples, Soldiers, etc.
Imperial Treasury, Albina in man's dress.
Alessandro with Séguito, Claudio, and Salustia.
Giulia with paper in her hand, and sayings.
Imperial lodges. Alexander, and Sallustia from various parts.
Martian, Claudio, and then Albina on the sidelines.
The dining room is set for dinner. Sallustia in a servile dress, followed by ministers, who are going to set up the canteen.
Alexander, Martian, and the foregoing aside.
Imperial thermal baths. Julia, Alessandro, Salustia.
Martian with Séguito, and the above.

Imperial hall, at the bottom of which you can see the descent of the palace of the Happiness of Rome. It precedes great symphony; and meanwhile descend from the upper stairs the Soldiers, and Roman Peoples, then Alexander with Julia, then Salustia, Martian; then Albina, and Claudio.
